# R5 — exact completion of all 249 contextual eight-state f=8 extensions

Scientific status: AUTHOR_PROVED / EXACT_FINITE_CHECKED / NOT_REVIEWED.
Date: 2026-11-18. This is an author-side finite scalar-observer theorem; no native X6-state identification, formal Task CLAIM/RUN, independent review, or project admission is claimed.

## Frozen science and theorem

Frozen input: enterprise-math commit 435e77af0d180eac32bd1f9c4c464bc4010b7551. Exact table EXACT_R5_ALL_101_BUDGETS.json SHA256 50e87f0194cfb3780e84b7bbb6f9a2dca4f79bb4901cab06f1a5b59256fb470b. Query budgets k=214,...,314 (cost=k), 256 individually named integer-center hypotheses N_h(k); real correct responses satisfy |y-N_h(k)| <= tau/2 and up to f=8 arbitrary unmarked errors. Let L=25845652773852463277015040000 and U=58182461585441404127941754880.

Set H0=(18,24,82,34,17), Q=(144,208), and for each x in {0,...,255} minus (H0 union Q), let H_x=(18,24,82,34,17,x,144,208), with eight distinct named slots. Then the exact adaptive zero-error-identification cost with up to eight bad responses is

**C_8(H_x,tau) = 8335 for every one of 249 x, at every real L <= tau < U.**

The result does NOT determine the full-256-state optimum: its independently established bracket 8335 <= C_8*(tau) <= 8343 remains unchanged.

## Proof

1. Observer-safe contextual quotient. At query k and noise diameter tau, the maximally informative response descriptions are inclusion-maximal correct-candidate support masks S(y)={i:|y-N_i(k)|<=tau/2}. A support can be enumerated by sliding a closed center window of width tau starting at one of the eight centers, discarding proper-subset supports. Independently sweeping all doubled response endpoints and intervening open cells gives identical maximal families. Over all 101 actions and 18 half-open noise chambers cut by the 17 internal pairwise-center differences, the 249 candidate x have exactly 53 distinct complete support signatures, preserving all eight named error counters and all permitted subsequent actions. This is the scope-limited quotient already proved and verified in the predecessor R5 249-to-53 certificate; no X6/provenance state is erased.
2. Exact finite minimax recurrence. Each vector e=(e_1,...,e_8) has counters 0,...,9, where 9 means eliminated. A response support S sends e_i to min(9,e_i+1[i not in S]) for still-live slots. V(e)=0 with at most one counter <=8; otherwise V(e)=min_k [k+max_{maximal S for k} V(T_S(e))]. Positive-cost self-loop actions may be omitted from unrestricted minimization; every other transition strictly increases a noneliminated counter, proving finite termination. The 101 original budgets may be compressed only when their full support families agree, retaining the least cost; this preserves V.
3. Endpoint calculations. The predecessor immutable result R5_19_F8_ENDPOINT_RESULTS.json has exact C_8=8335 at both tau=L and tau=U-1 for 19 distinct classes (38 runs, 64 candidates). This continuation compiled the original exact C++ integer Bellman solver using g++ 14.2.0 -O3 -std=c++17 and solved **all 34 remaining distinct classes** at BOTH endpoints (68 fresh runs, 185 candidates). Every new run returned EXACT cost=8335 with explicit memo state and action-family counts; see NEW_34_ENDPOINTS.tsv and source archive. The original 19 and new 34 representatives exactly exhaust all 53 contextual classes, and their members partition all 249 candidates.
4. Every correct-response support relation is monotone with increasing tau; hence C_8(H_x,tau) is nondecreasing in tau. The pairwise integer-center distances are integers; with U an integer, no additional support threshold occurs in [U-1,U). Thus the right-limit support family equals that at U-1. Since both endpoints have value 8335, every real tau in [L,U) does too.

## Exact validation and provenance

- The 53-class partition validator from the predecessor passed with frozen table SHA256 above; independent sweep crosschecks: 53 x 101 x 18 = 96,354.
- The prior 19 classes were **reused**, not recomputed. The new 34 were genuinely solved in this continuation with the same exact C++ solver and deterministic input builder; results checked against all 53 representatives and both endpoint boundaries. Total end-point certificate coverage: 106 class-endpoint values; new=68.
- Arithmetic: arbitrary-precision Python integer generation of centers/supports; C++ 64-bit state encoding of eight 4-bit error counters and exact int optimal costs, no floating-point mathematical decisions. The number of possible counter states is finite. Recorded memo states are algorithmic runtime evidence, not separate physical states.
- Verification grade: AUTHOR_PROVED / EXACT_FINITE_CHECKED / NOT_REVIEWED. The computational proof depends on the frozen table and the correctness of the included exact solver and enumeration procedures; no independent adversarial code review has occurred.

## Reproduction and next open question

Compile EXACT_EIGHT_SUBSET.cpp and run REPRODUCE_34.py using the frozen exact table and predecessor R5_249_CONTEXT_CLASSES.json, then compare every result against NEW_34_ENDPOINTS.tsv; verify the predecessor 19-class JSON. Existing historical code and source are pinned to prior R5 research at commit c1bfdfccf1b4986dda0b30154aab0d7631a0fdf0.

The precise next problem is to find a **nine-state-or-larger joint hard subset** with C_8>8335, or an explicit full-256-state adaptive policy below 8343. The completed family rules out every eight-state witness of the restricted form H0 union {144,208,x}; it does not rule out other eight-state or higher-cardinality witnesses.
